0.label: Food
0.description: Employed residents, counted where they live (INE Annual Population Census, 1 January 2024): agriculture, livestock, forestry and fishing (CNAE section A).

1.label: Production
1.description: Employed residents, counted where they live (INE Annual Population Census, 1 January 2024): mining and quarrying (B), manufacturing (C) and construction (F), the three sectors of the US map.

2.label: Gold
2.description: Gross domestic product at market prices, in current euros (INE Regional Accounts of Spain). INE publishes it down to provinces, so cities have no gold of their own.

3.label: Science
3.description: R&D personnel in full-time equivalents, counted where the R&D is done (INE R&D statistic, 2025: businesses, government, higher education and non-profit institutions). INE publishes it by autonomous community; each province and each city gets the part of its community's that its residents employed in information and communication (J) and professional, scientific and technical activities (M) earn it, by the Annual Population Census (2024). Spain is INE's national total; Ceuta and Melilla have no figure (statistical confidentiality).

4.label: Culture
4.description: Employed residents, counted where they live (INE Annual Population Census, 1 January 2024): arts, entertainment and recreation (R).
